question: Using the validated identity-before-scoring instrument (4-condition conjunction) from EXP-INTEL-36306525220: which PUBLISHED web-agent systems actually persist state across sessions or episodes, and does ANY report a cost quantity with denominator, accounting convention, stated uncertainty, and a MEASURED break-even reuse count f*? Separately and bounded: does any published system report a MEASURED stationarity metric for the state it carries?
hypothesis: At least one published web-agent system that persists state across sessions/episodes reports a measured break-even reuse count f* with denominator, accounting convention, and stated uncertainty. Separately: at least one such system reports a measured stationarity metric for its persistent state.
falsifier: After exhaustive construction-seeded search (PC bibliography seeds + 3 external systems + 1 bounded 1-hop snowball via Semantic Scholar author-title-year), zero candidates satisfy the identity conjunction AND report a measured f* with denominator/convention/uncertainty. Separately: zero candidates report a measured stationarity metric.

B-PUBLISHED-NUMBERS-ONLY.description: Read-only extraction from published artifacts; no reproduction, no SPIDER measurements. Same as EXP-INTEL-36306525220 prereg section 10.

B-NULL-FUZZY-RECALL.description: Name-recall search (Google Scholar fuzzy query for 'persistent state web agent', 'cross-episode memory agent', 'break-even reuse count agent') without identity conjunction. Expected to retrieve irrelevant/noisy results.

positive_control.description: arXiv:2608.05784v1 (Activity Frames) — the verified positive control from EXP-INTEL-36306525220 that contains a complete per-task cost model (Eq. 1) with reuse count N as a symbolic term, explicitly states 'the one input none of them measures is h on the pre-delegation passive corpus', and reports modeled (not billed) dollar comparisons. This control validates that the field-extraction pipeline can extract cost-accounting fields when the identity gate passes. Frozen target: arXiv:2608.05784v1 with expected_authors=['Iyamu', 'Nossa'] (corrected from ['TBD']).
positive_control.expected_behavior: Identity gate passes (C1 exact base_id, C2 title token coverage >=0.85, C3 author substring match, C4 >=4/6 domain keywords). Field extraction yields: break_even_reuse_count_fstar=NOT_REPORTED_AS_A_COMPUTED_QUANTITY (0 pattern hits over full text), real_cost_advantage_persistence=no_measured_real_cost_advantage, staleness_forgetting_maintenance_cost=NOT_REPORTED_AS_A_QUANTIFIED_COST, modeled_vs_measured=modeled_explicitly_stated.
positive_control.pass_criteria: All four identity conditions pass AND field extraction produces the four expected determinations with verbatim quotes.

null_control.description: arXiv:1802.05012v2 ('Getting out of the closet': Scientific authorship of literary fiction and knowledge transfer, 2018, Azagra-Caro et al.) — a REAL artifact at a frozen identifier that is NOT a web-agent system. Validated in EXP-INTEL-36306525220: resolver flagged C2_title_mismatch and C3_author_mismatch, emitted AMBIGUOUS -> UNMEASURED, never NOT_FOUND. C4 domain-keyword condition ALONE would have passed (contains 'agent' token), proving the 4-condition conjunction is necessary for specificity.
null_control.expected_behavior: Identity gate fails at C2 and/or C3, emits AMBIGUOUS -> UNMEASURED, never NOT_FOUND.
null_control.pass_criteria: Resolver records pass=null with reason containing C2_title_mismatch or C3_author_mismatch; resolution_status=UNMEASURED; never resolution_status=NOT_FOUND.

measurement_validity.identity_gate: Four-condition conjunction (C1 exact base_id match, C2 case-insensitive substring + expected_token_coverage >=0.85 per Director ruling, C3 at least one author substring match, C4 >=4 of 6 domain keywords). All conditions must pass for identity_resolution=RESOLVED. Any failure -> AMBIGUOUS -> UNMEASURED. Never NOT_FOUND.
measurement_validity.construct_population: Candidate set built BY CONSTRUCTION only: (1) PC bibliography seeds: 'Agent workflow memory' (Wang, Mao, Fried, Neubig 2024) and 'Position: Episodic memory is the missing piece for long-term LLM agents' (Pink et al. 2025); (2) External systems from last packet: Agent Workflow Memory, WebCoach, ReasoningBank; (3) Exactly ONE bounded 1-hop snowball: references from the PC artifact resolved by author-title-year against Semantic Scholar graph API (api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1), maximum 20 candidates, frozen at design time. The 14 frozen benchmark entries from EXP-INTEL-36306525220 are EXCLUDED. The 3 wrong identifiers (BrowserGym 2401.15378, MiniWoB++ 1802.08827, SeeAct 2402.04566) are EXCLUDED — no post-hoc repair.
measurement_validity.field_extraction: For each RESOLVED candidate, extract verbatim quotes for: (a) persists_state_across_sessions (yes/no/UNKNOWN, never inferred from keywords), (b) cost_quantity_denominator, (c) cost_quantity_accounting_convention, (d) cost_quantity_stated_uncertainty, (e) break_even_reuse_count_fstar (value or NOT_REPORTED_AS_A_COMPUTED_QUANTITY), (f) modeled_vs_measured (modeled/measured/unknown), (g) stationarity_metric (value or NOT_REPORTED, with denominator/convention/uncertainty if present).
measurement_validity.coverage_reporting: Report: n_candidates_searched, n_resolved, n_persisting_state_yes, n_persisting_state_no, n_persisting_state_unknown, n_reporting_fstar_measured, n_reporting_stationarity_measured. Separate snowball coverage (papers_examined, papers_resolved) from seed coverage. Never use identity_resolution_recall as construct-population proxy.
measurement_validity.substrate: stdlib HTTP only (urllib/requests). No browser, no Docker, no model credentials. arXiv via https://arxiv.org/abs/<id> (HTTP 200 verified). Semantic Scholar Graph API (HTTP 200 verified on substrate probe).

part_A_primary.outcome_SUPPORTS: At least one RESOLVED candidate with persists_state_across_sessions=yes AND break_even_reuse_count_fstar reported as a MEASURED quantity (not modeled) WITH explicit denominator, accounting convention, and stated uncertainty.
part_A_primary.outcome_FALSIFIES: Zero RESOLVED candidates with persists_state_across_sessions=yes AND break_even_reuse_count_fstar measured with denominator/convention/uncertainty. All candidates either: do not persist state, or report f* only as modeled/symbolic, or lack denominator/convention/uncertainty.
part_A_primary.outcome_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one RESOLVED candidate with persists_state_across_sessions=yes but break_even_reuse_count_fstar status=NOT_REPORTED_AS_A_COMPUTED_QUANTITY or modeled_only, AND no candidate meets SUPPORTS criteria.
part_A_primary.outcome_MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Identity gate fails validation (PC-COST-ACCOUNTING fails OR NC-REAL-BUT-WRONG resolves to RESOLVED OR emits NOT_FOUND), OR substrate fails (arXiv abs/ or Semantic Scholar API non-200 on >50% probes), OR field extraction fails on PC-COST-ACCOUNTING.

part_B_stationarity.outcome_SUPPORTS: At least one RESOLVED candidate with persists_state_across_sessions=yes AND stationarity_metric reported as MEASURED with denominator, convention, and uncertainty.
part_B_stationarity.outcome_FALSIFIES: Zero RESOLVED candidates with persists_state_across_sessions=yes AND measured stationarity_metric with denominator/convention/uncertainty.
part_B_stationarity.outcome_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one RESOLVED candidate with persists_state_across_sessions=yes but stationarity_metric NOT_REPORTED or modeled_only.
part_B_stationarity.outcome_MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Same as Part A (shared identity gate and substrate).

decision_rule.overall: Part A and Part B are separately scored. Overall experiment status = MEASUREMENT_INVALID if either part is MEASUREMENT_INVALID; otherwise COMPLETE with per-part outcomes.

product_consequence_positive: If Part A SUPPORTS: external corroboration that SPIDER's cross-episode persistence premise has measured economic precedent; Product can anchor C-PRODUCT-ECON's next_gate to a published f* benchmark. If Part B SUPPORTS: external evidence that stationarity measurement is a reporting practice, informing Runtime's freshness guard design.
product_consequence_negative: If Part A FALSIFIES: the field has no measured break-even reuse count — SPIDER's premise is economically unprecedented; Product must generate its own f* internally. If Part B FALSIFIES: stationarity reporting is absent; Runtime must invent freshness metrics. If INCONCLUSIVE: question remains open; next cycle may widen snowball or change seeds.

estimated_cost.http_requests: ~100 (arXiv abs + Semantic Scholar API + PDF/text extraction for ~25 candidates)

expected_information_gain: High. This is the first construct-population search (not benchmark-list search) for the decisive C-PRODUCT-ECON question. The identity instrument is validated; the population defect is diagnosed; the snowball rule is now executable via Semantic Scholar API. A valid outcome either way changes the factory's architectural premise.

Getting out of the closet: Scientific authorship of literary fiction and knowledge transfer

conjunction_conditions.C2_title_substring_coverage: Case-insensitive expected token coverage >= 0.85 (Director ruling: substring + coverage, NOT full-token-set Jaccard)
conjunction_conditions.C3_author_substring: At least one expected author surname substring match in returned author list
conjunction_conditions.C4_domain_keywords: At least 4 of 6 domain keywords present in title+abstract
